## Web Release Gate

If this PR changes a website, landing page, storefront, public/customer-facing web app or PWA, complete the following. Mark non-applicable items `N/A — reason`.

- [ ] Legal/privacy requirements reviewed
- [ ] Cookie/tracker consent behavior is correct
- [ ] HTTPS / mixed-content / security headers checked
- [ ] Titles + meta descriptions + canonical/social metadata checked
- [ ] Structured data validated when applicable
- [ ] sitemap.xml / robots.txt / indexability checked
- [ ] Favicon/app icons checked
- [ ] Alt text + image optimization checked
- [ ] Mobile/responsive layout checked
- [ ] WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility spot-check completed
- [ ] Performance/Core Web Vitals regression reviewed
- [ ] 404/error path checked
- [ ] Broken critical links/CTAs = 0
- [ ] Forms have server validation + abuse protection when applicable
- [ ] WhatsApp conversion entry checked or marked N/A
- [ ] Analytics/consent/observability checked
- [ ] One dominant primary CTA per page/hero/state
- [ ] Google Business Profile consistency checked or marked N/A
- [ ] Staging/preview indexing boundary checked
- [ ] Exact deployed SHA + desktop/mobile public smoke + rollback path recorded

Canonical policy: `docs/control/WEB_RELEASE_STANDARD_V1.md`.
